rules.description: Caps Lock: Hold = Ctrl, Tap = Fn (language switch)
Vim: jk → Escape (insert mode exit). Outputs 'j' immediately if not followed by 'k'
Vim Navigation: Ctrl + hjkl → Arrow Keys

manipulators.description: Ctrl + Shift + g (G): End of document
Ctrl + Shift + d: Delete entire line
Ctrl + Shift + y: Yank (copy) entire line
Ctrl + Shift + b: Delete back to word boundary
Ctrl + slash: Open search (maps to Cmd+F)
